newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: EDP selloff seen after June 1998-paper.
newsitem.headline: EDP selloff seen after June 1998-paper.

text.p: The second stage privatisation of EDP-Electricidade de Portugal will take place after June 1998 and will include a slice of capital to be allocated to foreign energy companies, a government official was quoted as saying.

"It (sell-off) will take place after June 1998. I don't want to fix dates, because the resolution of the cabinet will be in 1998 or 1999," Jose Penedos, Under-Secretary for Energy, told Diario de Noticias newspaper.
"A slice of the capital (in the second stage privatisation) will be destined for companies in the energy sector," he added.

Commenting on rumours that Spanish energy company Endesa had been buying EDP shares on Lisbon bourse, Penedos said that "if I were Endesa I would buy," adding that EDP could also buy stakes in Spanish energy companies.
The Socialist government of Prime Minister Antonio Guterres sold a 30 percent stake in EDP, Portugal's dominant electricity producer and distributor, in a first stage privatisation last month.
